Revision snapshot bbfe933c3a567a21391a5a21a7fc0a19e8e5de67 (isolated, parent 52201b9) is ready for re-review; my branch is pushed. All five findings fixed and re-applied over the reversible records; audit-authored 114/114 and every text reference corpus-wide resolves. (1) fazilat-svrhjmah and sura-svrh-alzlzlh r00001 restored to kind audio-reciter in plan and layout. (2) dua-hftm-daayy-zman r00004/ar cut 456 moved to 511, just after the jaur question, where its Persian closes. (3) monajat-mnajat-tlb-rvzy r00002 and amal-byst-6 r00002 now pair ar part i with fa part i. (4) ziyarat-ashura r00052: the first «وَ مَماتِي» sits at code point 64, not 99; the cut moved there so the doubled phrase stays whole in one piece, with an issue note documenting the once-translated repetition. (5) On the 25 alignment candidates: I re-scanned the full set in both directions and read every candidate with context. Genuine and fixed: amal-aamal-msjd-shlh r00007 (cut moved after «الْوَهَّابُ.»), monajat-mnajat-amyr-alyh r00006 (every cut moved before the dangling «مَوْلايَ»/«أَنْتَ» that opens the next stanza), sahifa-19 r00003 («دَائِمٍ» joined the piece holding its translation), plus a dangling comma in amal-aamal-msjd-shlh r00012. The remaining candidates are punctuation style: the Persian fully translates its Arabic and closes with a period where the Arabic continues with a comma. Two source-corpus row shifts that the same-row layout cannot re-home are now documented as issue notes: amal-hsyn-alyh-alslam r00133 fa carries the next row's «الْحَمْدُلِلّهِ» lead-in, and namaz-sadq-alyh-alslam r00003 fa repeats the full litany while its ar splits it across two rows.
